# Native workflow budgets

Follow [GitHub automation](../AGENTS.md) and [CI guidance](../../docs/CI.md).

Integration #9 raises both PR and main/manual native verification budgets to 30 minutes for the larger integrated suite. Retain every existing check, exact-commit guard, dedicated free foreground runner, permissions, and the publisher's 10-minute budget. The author's first 133-case native run took 19 minutes 18 seconds with one legacy picker-test failure; the budget leaves room for the unchanged tooling, discovery, and builds and does not certify CI success. Main pushes continue verification without publication; readiness still requires the reviewed tracked flag and explicit manual dispatch.

Issue #104 raises both native verification budgets to 40 minutes for the preserved full suite plus three actual endless flows. The first new Files flow alone passed in 257.824 seconds; the original 133-case run took about 19 minutes 18 seconds, and the additional all-game and system-accessibility flows require further time. Keep all checks and the publisher's separate 10-minute bound. This capacity change does not authorize test weakening, parallel simulator jobs, publication, or paid execution. Final measured local/CI evidence belongs in [ENDLESS.md](../../docs/ENDLESS.md).

Issue #106 raises both native verification budgets to 45 minutes. The merged #104 main job took 32 minutes 38 seconds; #106 adds a measured 293.839-second demo flow and extends all-game and system-accessibility flows. The prior 40-minute bound leaves too little room for changed native imports and builds. Retain all checks, the publisher's 10-minute bound, serialized owned simulators, and the existing free foreground runner. See [demo verification](../../docs/DEMO_NEWS.md#verification-and-handoff) for actual focused results; this budget does not certify the new full CI run.

## Testing priority #90

[TESTING.md](../../docs/TESTING.md) supersedes the prior always-serial/full-duplicate execution policy. Retain 45-minute failure bounds. The owner-approved pre-design gate runs all units plus three UI smoke cases on one owned simulator; retained long UI suites run only through explicit selection until a recorded design decision and reviewed source change. The older 139-case two-worker benchmark is historical evidence and cannot choose workers for this smaller inventory. PRs test exact reviewed heads; explicitly authorized manual releases may inherit proven reviewed squash-tree evidence with actual source build/install/launch smoke and fresh unique Release compilation. Missing or mismatched gate/provenance falls back to the complete active gate. Manual release verification needs an explicit token plus read-only Actions/checks/PR/commit-status access; this adds no verification writes, uploads, scheduler or publication authorization.

Main verification and the publisher both require `statuses: read` to read the original commit's independent review status during inheritance validation. The publisher declares job-specific permissions, which replace workflow permissions, so retain the scope in both blocks. It grants no status writes; see [API permission rationale](../../docs/CI.md#verification-contract).

## PR-only routine execution #112

The owner instructed "dont do a second check on main" on October 4, 2026. `verification.yml` accepts only same-repository pull requests; `releases.yml` accepts only `workflow_dispatch`, and both release jobs require that event on main. Never restore a push/schedule/workflow-run trigger or dispatch a manual run as a substitute after merging. Exact-head PR checks and fresh independent review remain required. Manual dispatch is reserved for explicitly owner-authorized publication; preserve its native/provenance and immutable metadata gates. The prior #90 automatic-main proof is historical.
